scenario: Two friends are hanging out at home and deciding what music to listen to
learner_goal: Listen to your favorite band (<extra_info>Extra information: your favorite band just released a new album</extra_info>)
partner_goal: Listen to a peaceful classical music to relax (<extra_info>Extra information: you had a stressful day and you just want to relax with some classical music</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Samuel Anderson
transcript.content: Hey Oliver, my favorite band just released a new album — want to check it out? I can queue it up now and whip up some snacks while we listen.

transcript.speaker: Oliver Smith
transcript.content: Hey Sam, that sounds great — and snacks are always welcome — but I had a pretty stressful day and was really hoping for something calm. Mind if we put on some peaceful classical music for a bit? Maybe piano or strings to unwind, then we can queue your album afterwards.

transcript.speaker: Samuel Anderson
transcript.content: Totally get that — let’s do calm piano/strings first. I’ll queue a mellow classical playlist and whip up some snacks. How long do you want to unwind before I put on my band’s new album — 30 minutes okay?

transcript.speaker: Oliver Smith
transcript.content: Thanks, Sam — 30 minutes sounds perfect. I appreciate you queuing a mellow piano/strings playlist and making snacks. I’ll grab a seat and unwind; then we can check out your band’s new album.
